remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath single-level condo in highly sought-after Upper Springdale-just 1.2 miles from Metro-North with an express commute to Grand Central in under one hour.  This move-in ready home features a private entrance, central air conditioning, and a bright eat-in kitchen perfect for everyday living. The spacious open-concept living and dining area is ideal for entertaining, with sliding glass doors leading to a large private deck-perfect for outdoor dining or relaxing.  The primary suite offers a comfortable retreat with a dressing area, full bath, and a generous walk-in closet. A second full bath includes an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience.  Additional highlights include closets galore, a large private storage room, assigned parking just steps from the unit (#16), and plenty of additional parking.  Enjoy low-maintenance living in a commuter-friendly location close to restaurants, shopping, library, school, dining, parks, and major highways. SELLER HAS REQUESTED BEST AND FINAL OFFERS BY 5 PM MONDAY 4/13/26.
